fun_fact: У кожистой черепахи нет твёрдого панциря — её спина покрыта кожей, похожей на резину.
hint: Самая крупная из морских черепах, переплывает океаны и питается в основном медузами.

weight_kg.note: Adults 250-700 kg, midpoint; largest verified specimen 650 kg (Harlech turtle 916 kg is doubted)

length_m.note: Total length 1.83-2.2 m, midpoint; up to 2.7 m

speed_kmh.note: Swimming: typical 1.8-10.08 km/h; Guinness 1992 record 35.28 km/h

lifespan_years.note: Estimates range 30-50+ years; 2020 CSIRO genomic estimate 90.4 years; NOAA says 45-50+

dive_depth_m.note: Deepest recorded dive 1,280 m; NOAA gives ~4,000 ft (1,220 m); ADW 1,230 m

teeth_count.note: No teeth; sharp points on the beak and backward spines in the throat instead

fun_fact: Манта имеет самый большой мозг среди всех рыб и может узнавать себя в зеркале.
hint: Огромный плоский скат с «крыльями», который парит в толще воды и фильтрует планктон.

weight_kg.note: Mantas reach 1,350 kg (Manta ray page); Giant oceanic manta ray page claims weight around 3,000 kg for 7 m disc — sources differ >2x, 1,350 used as avg

length_m.note: Disc width (wingtip to wingtip): typical 4.5 m, up to 7 m across; some sources claim 9 m

speed_kmh.note: Swimming up to 24 km/h; cruising ~10 km/h during mating chase (Manta ray page)

lifespan_years.note: May live as long as 50 years; typical not stated, avg is an estimate

gestation_days.note: Gestation thought to be 12-13 months; one recorded pregnancy 372 days

dive_depth_m.note: Satellite-tagged M. birostris descended to at least 1,250 m

fun_fact: Широкая голова-молот работает как металлоискатель — ей акула находит скатов, спрятавшихся в песке.
hint: Акула с плоской широкой головой, похожей на молоток, охотится на скатов у дна.

weight_kg.note: Typical adults over 230 kg; heaviest known 580 kg female (Boca Grande 2006); max commonly cited 449.5 kg

length_m.note: Total length typical 3.5-4.6 m, midpoint; max 6.1-6.2 m

lifespan_years.note: Typically 20-30 years; record female estimated 40-50; ADW gives oldest recorded 44

dive_depth_m.note: Habitat depth to 80 m offshore (Wikipedia); ADW habitat range 1-300 m. Not a dive record

teeth_count.note: Functional row: upper 17 per side + 2-3 symphysial, lower 16-17 per side + 1-3 symphysial = ~70 teeth; calculated from Wikipedia counts. ADW: over 30 rows in upper jaw

deaths_per_year.note: ISAF: 34 bites by Sphyrna as of 2011 (17 unprovoked), none fatal

fun_fact: Узор из пятен на спине китовой акулы уникален, как отпечаток пальца у человека.
hint: Самая большая рыба на планете, мирно процеживает планктон огромной пастью.

weight_kg.note: Karachi 2012 specimen around 15,000 kg; typical adult weight not given in Wikipedia; ADW lists high 30,844 kg (unverified)

length_m.note: Total length; males mature at 8-9 m, most observed smaller than 18-20 m; largest reliably recorded 18.8 m; ADW average 7 m

speed_kmh.note: Swimming: cruises 0.05-1.0+ m/s; satellite tracking up to 3.9 km/h. Wikipedia only says slow-moving

fun_fact: Белуху прозвали «морской канарейкой» за свист, щебет и трели, которыми она болтает с сородичами.
hint: Белоснежный кит северных морей с мягкой «шишкой» на лбу и очень гибкой шеей.

weight_kg.note: Males 1,100-1,600 kg, midpoint; occasionally up to 1,900 kg

length_m.note: Total length, males 3.5-5.5 m midpoint; females 3-4.1 m

speed_kmh.note: Swimming: typically 3-9 km/h; can sustain 22 km/h for up to 15 min

lifespan_years.note: Estimated 70-80 years possible; oldest living 79; ADW wild 40-60+, midpoint used

gestation_days.note: Gestation 12-14.5 months (~400 days); captive data up to 475 days; NOAA ~15 months

dive_depth_m.note: Wild record over 900 m; NOAA: dives to 1,000 m for up to 25 min; captive 400-647 m

teeth_count.note: Total 36-40 small blunt teeth, 8-10 per side per jaw

heart_bpm.note: Resting ~100 bpm, drops to 12-20 bpm during dives

fun_fact: Самцы горбатых китов поют длинные песни, которые меняются из года в год, как модные хиты.
hint: Большой кит с очень длинными плавниками, который выпрыгивает из воды и поёт часами.

weight_kg.note: Up to 40 metric tons (Wikipedia, NOAA); ADW average mass 30,000 kg

length_m.note: Total length adults 14-15 m midpoint; longest reliably 17.4 m male (18.6 m female record considered unlikely)

speed_kmh.note: Swimming: cruising 7.9-15.1 km/h midpoint; up to 27 km/h when threatened

lifespan_years.note: May live over 50 years; oldest recorded 95; NOAA says 80-90 years

dive_depth_m.note: Typical dives up to 80 m; occasionally as deep as 616 m

teeth_count.note: No teeth in adults; 540-800 baleen plates (fetuses start with teeth)

fun_fact: Морской леопард часами поёт под водой, а в его пасти есть и острые зубы, и «сито» для процеживания криля.
hint: Пятнистый антарктический тюлень с длинной змеиной шеей, охотник на пингвинов.

weight_kg.note: Adults 200-600 kg midpoint; females up to 50% larger (ADW: males ~300 kg, females to 500 kg)

length_m.note: Total length 2.4-3.5 m midpoint; ADW females up to 3.8 m

lifespan_years.note: Wild up to 26 years (Wikipedia); ADW: average 26, recorded up to 30

dive_depth_m.note: Primarily shallow divers, capable of diving deeper than 80 m; no documented record depth

tooth_length_cm.note: Canine teeth up to 2.5 cm long (exposed crown)

loudness_db.note: Male underwater calls 153-177 dB re 1 μPa at 1 m, midpoint

deaths_per_year.note: One recorded human fatality ever (Kirsty Brown, 2003); annual rate effectively 0

fun_fact: Самцы морских слонов раздувают нос-хобот и ревут так, что их слышно на всём пляже.
hint: Самый тяжёлый тюлень в мире, самцы с хоботом месяцами ныряют в холодном океане.

weight_kg.note: Adult bulls 3,000-3,700 kg midpoint; exceptional males up to 4,000 kg (Elephant seal page); females much smaller

length_m.note: Bulls 4.6-5.8 m including rear flippers, midpoint; exceptional up to 6 m

speed_kmh.note: Only figure given: as fast as 10 km/h over short distances (on land); swimming speed not documented in sources opened

lifespan_years.note: Average lifespan of southern elephant seal 21 years; ADW: males to 14, females to 20+; max not firmly documented

gestation_days.note: Gestation 11 months incl. delayed implantation (~335 days); ADW/AnAge gives 220 days active gestation

dive_depth_m.note: Deepest recorded dive 2,388 m; dives can exceed 100 min

sleep_hours.note: About two hours of sleep a day during the ~7 months at sea, in <20-min bouts while sinking

fun_fact: Чёрная мамба вовсе не чёрная — она серая или оливковая, а чёрной у неё только внутренность пасти.
hint: Длинная быстрая африканская змея, которая приподнимает переднюю часть тела и раскрывает тёмную пасть.

weight_kg.note: Reported body mass about 1.6 kg; study of 7 snakes averaged 1.03 kg, heaviest 2.4 kg

length_m.note: Total length 2-3 m midpoint; specimens of 4.3-4.5 m reported

speed_kmh.note: Ground speed up to 16 km/h over short distances; article elsewhere says cannot exceed 20 km/h (ADW: up to 20 km/h)

lifespan_years.note: Recorded to live up to 11 years (captive), may live longer; ADW captive female average 10.1 years; wild typical unknown

gestation_days.note: Egg incubation 80-90 days (2-3 months); clutch 6-17 eggs per Wikipedia

tooth_length_cm.note: Fangs up to 6.5 mm long (whole fang)

fun_fact: Ядозуб запасает жир в толстом хвосте и почти всю жизнь проводит под землёй, выходя наружу лишь иногда.
hint: Крупная медлительная пустынная ящерица Северной Америки с бугристой чёрно-оранжевой кожей.

weight_kg.note: Typical body mass 550-800 g midpoint; San Diego Zoo gives 0.7-1.4 kg; Nat Geo 4 lb (1.8 kg) popular claim

length_m.note: Total length; largest specimens 51-56 cm; snout-vent 26-36 cm; typical total ~45 cm estimated

lifespan_years.note: Up to 20 years in native range, over 30 years in captivity (Nat Geo: up to 40 captive); Wikipedia gives no lifespan

gestation_days.note: Incubation: eggs laid late May-June, hatch late October (~5 months, implied by Wikipedia). San Diego Zoo: 4 months; ADW: ~10 months incl. overwintering — sources differ >2x

deaths_per_year.note: One confirmed fatality since 1930 (Colorado, Feb 2024); annual rate effectively 0
